company.name: LuxCreo Inc.
company.shortDescription: LuxCreo invented the first full-stack, FDA Class II 510(k) cleared additive platform to transform the dental clear aligner industry.
company.description: Launched in 2017, LuxCreo Inc. is at the forefront of dental innovation with the first full-stack, FDA Class II 510(k) cleared additive manufacturing platform. Specializing in 3D printed dental solutions, LuxCreo boosts productivity by 3-10 times in dental clinics and laboratories, allowing for the efficient same-day creation of aligners, retainers, night guards, and splints. This transformational approach ensures rapid delivery, elevating patient care with unmatched precision, speed, and hygiene.

aiResearchSummary.text: LuxCreo Inc. is researching systems and methods for orthodontic appliance production, including determining baseline thickness for orthodontic appliances, as described in 'Systems and methods for orthodontic appliance production.' The company is also developing additive manufacturing devices and methods, such as those using light sources to cure photocurable resins, and composite release films for separating cured layers during 3D printing. These efforts focus on dental aligner manufacturing and related additive technologies.
